name: AK11T - Indoor CO2 Monitor & Detector (CO2, Temperature, Humidity), Portable
highlights: The Lowest-Cost Way to Put CO₂ in Every Room — When the goal is one monitor per classroom or per meeting room, unit price decides how many rooms get covered. This is the entry point in the range.

Right for Occupancy, Not for Certification — A semiconductor element tracks the rise and fall that tells you to open a window — exactly what a classroom or meeting room needs. NDIR accuracy is available in the same enclosure as AK11H.
Bar Readout — The colour bar under the digits moves green to red as the level climbs, so occupants act on the band without learning what 1000 ppm means.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours — Three-hour USB charge, 206 g, lanyard included.
Built for Volume — 50 pcs per carton, 25,000 units per 20 ft container — the highest unit density in the multi-room deployment range.
